original: kālāvacchinnatvaṃ ca pratipādya eka eva śivaḥ sākṣāt sṛṣṭisthityantasiddhaye brahmaviṣṇuśivākhyābhiḥ kalpanābhirvijṛmbhitam| rajo guṇena sañchinno brahmādhiṣṭhāyataṃ guṇam| sraṣṭā bhavati sarvasya
analyzed: kāla avacchinna tvam ca pratipādya ekaḥ eva śivaḥ sākṣāt sṛṣṭi sthiti anta siddhaye brahma viṣṇu śiva ākhyābhiḥ kalpanābhiḥ vijṛmbhitam rajaḥ guṇena sañchinnaḥ brahma adhiṣṭhā āyatam guṇam sraṣṭā bhavati sarvasya

original: jagataḥ paṇḍitottamāḥ| guṇena tamasācchanno viṣṇuḥ satvaṃ guṇaṃ budhāḥ| adhiṣṭhāyābhāvatsarvajagataḥ pālakaḥ prabhuḥ| tathā satvaguṇacchanno rudro viprāstamoguṇam|
analyzed: jagataḥ paṇḍita uttamāḥ guṇena tamasā ācchannaḥ viṣṇuḥ satvam guṇam budhāḥ adhiṣṭhāya abhāvat sarva jagataḥ pālakaḥ prabhuḥ tathā satva guṇa channaḥ rudraḥ viprāḥ tamaḥ guṇam

original: adhiṣṭhāyābhāvaddhartā jagataḥ satyavādinaṃ nandadinā brahmaviṣṇurudrāṇāṃ pītanīlaśvetavarṇānāṃ tattadvarṇaviśeṣaucityānusāreṇa rajastamaḥ satvaguṇacchannatvaṃ sṛṣṭisthitisaṃhārarūpatattat
analyzed: adhiṣṭhāya abhāvat dhartā jagataḥ satya vādinam brahma viṣṇu rudrāṇām pīta nīla śveta varṇānām tad tad varṇa viśeṣa aucitya anusāreṇa rajaḥ tamaḥ satva guṇa channa tvam sṛṣṭi sthiti saṃhāra rūpa tad tad

original: kāryaviśeṣaucityānusāreṇa rajasaḥ satvatamo(-)guṇādhiṣṭhātṛtvaṃ ca pratipādya| brahmaṇo mūrtayo'nantā jāyante guṇabhedataḥ| tathā viṣṇoḥ tatheśasya guṇabhedanasuvratā iti
analyzed: kārya viśeṣa aucitya anusāreṇa rajasaḥ satva tamaḥ guṇa adhiṣṭhātṛ tvam ca pratipādya brahmaṇaḥ mūrtayaḥ anantāḥ jāyante guṇa bhedataḥ tathā viṣṇoḥ tathā īśasya guṇa bhedana suvratāḥ iti

original: brahmaviṣṇurudrāṇāmapi pratyekaṃ satvarajastamo guṇodrittā(tā) avāntaramūrtirabhidhāya| ko'nyaḥ saṃsāramagnānāmupāsyo mocakaḥ prabhuḥ| ṛte sākṣānmahādevamityeṣā

original: śāśvatī śrutiḥ| ityanena ślokena yadā carmavadākāśaṃ veṣṭayiṣyanti mānavāḥ| tadā śivamavijñāya duḥkhasyānto bhaviṣyatīti śrutipratipādyaṃ paramaśiva eva mokṣaprada
analyzed: śāśvatī śrutiḥ iti anena ślokena yadā carma vat ākāśam veṣṭayiṣyanti mānavāḥ tadā śivam a vijñāya duḥkhasya antaḥ bhaviṣyati iti śruti pratipādyam paramaśivaḥ eva mokṣa pradaḥ

original: ityamumarthaṃ pratipādyānantaraṃ navamādhyāye brahmā vaiṣṇavaṃ rūpamāsthāya vārāhaṃ rūpaṃ parigṛhya bhuvamuddhṛtya punarvaiṣṇavaṃ rūpaṃ parityajya meharūpamāsthāya
analyzed: iti amum artham pratipādya anantaram navama adhyāye brahmā vaiṣṇavam rūpam āsthāya vārāham rūpam parigṛhya bhuvam uddhṛtya punar vaiṣṇavam rūpam parityajya meha rūpam āsthāya

analyzed: mahādeva prasādāt pūrva sarga vid dhvastān amara ādīn sasarja iti pratyapādi nanu bhagavan viṣṇunā bhūmiḥ samuddhṛtā iti naimiśīyānām praśnasya

original: tadaikāmbunidhau naṣṭe jagati sthāvarādike viṣṇuḥ sākṣāt samudbhūtaḥ tadā tasmin mahodadhau| ityādi sūtakṛtottarasya ca paryālocanāyāṃ sākṣādviṣṇureva tatra pratipādyaḥ| na tu viriñcaguṇamūrti

analyzed: bhūtaḥ viṣṇuḥ iti pratīyate iti ced na etat samāna prakaraṇe viṣṇupurāṇe toya antām sa mahīm jñātvā jagati ekārṇave vibhuḥ anumānāt tad uddhāram kartu kāmaḥ prajāpatiḥ iti upakrame viriñce

original: rūḍhasya prajāpatiśabdasya prayogeṇopabrahmitāyā āpo vā idamagre salilamāsīttasmin prajāpatirvāyurbhūtvācarat sa imāmapaśyattāṃ varāho bhūtvā haraditi śruteḥ| visṛjya

original: rūpaṃ vārāhaṃ svayaṃ brahmā bhavaddhariḥ| sā mahī saṃsthitā viprā jalasyopari nauriva| tasyāṃ brahmā mahādevaprasādādeva suvratāḥ| pūrvasarge ca vidhvastānamarānakhilān prabhuḥ| yathā pūrvaṃ

original: dvijaḥ sraṣṭuṃ matiṃ cakre prajāpatiriti| sūtasaṃhitā śivamāhātmyakhaṇḍanavamādhyāyopasaṃhārasya ca paryālocanāyāṃ prajāpatirevātra pratipādya iti siddhe navamādhyāyaḥ|
analyzed: dvijaḥ sraṣṭum matim cakre prajāpatiḥ iti sūta saṃhitā śiva māhātmya khaṇḍa navama adhyāya upasaṃhārasya ca paryālocanāyām prajāpatiḥ eva atra pratipādyaḥ iti siddhe navama adhyāyaḥ

original: mādhavācāryaiḥ itthaṃ hi tadīyo granthaḥ viṣṇuḥ sākṣāditi brahmā hi aharavasāne viṣṇurūpaḥ śeṣaparyaṅke śayitvā varāharūpeṇa bhuvamuddhṛtya svenaivātmanā punarlotra(rlokatra)yamaśrākṣīt ata eva hi vakṣyeti visṛjyaṃ

original: rūpaṃ vārāhaṃ svayaṃ brahmā bhavaddhaririti na caivaṃ śāntikarmaṇi vetālodayaḥ viriñca parasya nārāyaṇaśabdaprayogasya nārāyaṇanāma nirvacanasya ca viriñcādhiṣṭhitavaiṣṇavarūpābhiprāyeṇaivopa
analyzed: rūpam vārāham svayam brahmā bhavat hariḥ iti na ca evam śānti karmaṇi vetāla udayaḥ viriñca parasya nārāyaṇa śabda prayogasya nārāyaṇa nāma nirvacanasya ca viriñca adhiṣṭhita vaiṣṇava rūpa abhiprāyeṇa eva upasthāpita

original: patyā viriñcaparatvasya bhaṅgāditi vācyam| bhuvamuddhṛtya vārāhaṃ vaiṣṇavaṃ ca rūpaṃ parityajya kaumārasargaparyantāṃ jagatsṛṣṭiṃ kṛtavataścaturmukhasya nārāyaṇa(-)nābhipadmādāvirbhāvamuktvā punaḥ sṛṣṭiṃ

original: pravṛttacaturmukhe so'pi yogaṃ samāsathāya sasarja vividhaṃ jagat| nārāyaṇākhyo bhagavān yathā pūrvaṃ prajāpatiriti sākṣāccaturmukha eva nārāyaṇaśabdaprayogāt viriñce nārāyaṇaśabdaprayogasyā
analyzed: pravṛtta caturmukhe saḥ api yogam samāsathāya sasarja vividham jagat nārāyaṇa ākhyaḥ bhagavān yathā pūrvam prajāpatiḥ iti sākṣāt caturmukhe eva nārāyaṇa śabda prayogāt viriñce nārāyaṇa śabda prayogasya ādhāraḥ

original: pratisiddhatvena pravṛttinimittakathanākāṅkṣāyāṃ tat śāntaye prāktanasya nārāyaṇanāmanirvacanasyāpyadhiṣṭhātṛviriñcaparatvamevocitaṃ labhate|
analyzed: pratisiddha tvena pravṛtti nimitta kathana ākāṅkṣāyām tat śāntaye prāktanasya nārāyaṇa nāma nirvacanasya api adhiṣṭhātṛ viriñca paratvam eva ucitam labhate

original: na tvadhiṣṭheyavaiṣṇavaparatvaṃ tatra nārāyaṇaśabdaprayogasya prasiddhatvena pravṛttinimittakathanākāṃkṣatvāt tasmādviriñcaparameva kaurmagatanārāyaṇanāmanirvacanaṃ eva| tasmā
analyzed: na tu adhiṣṭheya vaiṣṇava paratvam tatra nārāyaṇa śabda prayogasya prasiddha tvena pravṛtti nimitta kathana ākāṃkṣatvāt tasmāt viriñca param eva kaurma gata nārāyaṇa nāma nirvacanam eva tasmāt

original: daṇḍādabhūtsṛṣṭā śivātmā caturānanaḥ| sarvalokasya nirmātā brahmā viśvasṛjāṃ patiḥ| sa cāpsuśayanādeva śivātmā svecchayā ciram| nārāyaṇākhyāmabhajat śaktirūpaḥ prajāpatiriti āśvalāyana

original: dharmaśāstre viriñce nārāyaṇanāmanirvacanaṃ draṣṭavyam| śaṅkarānandayogi(-)bhirapi nārāyaṇaparo vyaktāditi gītābhāṣyasthamaṅgalaślokavyākhyānāvasare puruṣo ha vai nārāyaṇa
analyzed: dharmaśāstre viriñce nārāyaṇa nāma nirvacanam draṣṭavyam śaṅkara ānanda yogibhiḥ api nārāyaṇa paraḥ vyaktāt iti gītā bhāṣya stha maṅgalaśloka vyākhyāna avasare puruṣaḥ ha vai nārāyaṇa

original: iti nārāyaṇopaniṣadvyākhyāne ca avasare ca narāṇāṃ pratibimbabhūtajīvānāṃ bimbatvenāyano nārāyaṇaḥ sa eva nārāyaṇa iti nirviśeṣabrahmamaṇyapi nārāyaṇaśabdapravṛttirdarśitā| tasmāt śive
analyzed: iti nārāyaṇa upaniṣad vyākhyāne ca avasare ca narāṇām pratibimba bhūta jīvānām bimba tvena ayanaḥ nārāyaṇaḥ saḥ eva nārāyaṇaḥ iti nirviśeṣa brahma maṇi api nārāyaṇa śabda pravṛttiḥ darśitā tasmāt śive

original: tadanyasmin vā yatra ṇatvaviśiṣṭo yaugiko nārāyaṇaśabdaḥ prayujyate| tadbhinnārthaviśiṣṭasyaiva nārāyanaśabdasya bhubhnāditvaṃ kalpyaṃ na kevalaṃ nārāyaṇaśabda eveyaṃ rītiḥ kiṃ tu ṇatvayogyāyanaśabda
analyzed: tad anyasmin vā yatra ṇatva viśiṣṭaḥ yaugikaḥ nārāyaṇa śabdaḥ prayujyate tad bhinna artha viśiṣṭasya eva nārāyana śabdasya bhubhna ādi tvam kalpyam na kevalam nārāyaṇa śabdaḥ evā iyam rītiḥ kim tu ṇatva yogyā ayana śabdaḥ

original: ghaṭite'nyasminnapi śabde evameva kalpyam| ata eva praśnopaniṣadādau nadyasya syandamānāḥ samudrāyaṇāḥ ṣoḍaśakalāḥ puruṣāyaṇā ityādi prayujyate| tatra hyasmaduktarītyaiva ṇatvamupapādanīyam| nānyathā
analyzed: śabde evam eva kalpyam atas eva praśna upaniṣad ādau nadī asya syandamānāḥ samudrāyaṇāḥ ṣoḍaśakalāḥ puruṣāyaṇāḥ ityādi prayujyate tatra hi asmad ukta rītyā eva ṇa tvam upapādanīyam na anyathā

original: na ca tatra chāndasatvena nirvāhaḥ prakṛte'pi tulyatvāt subālopaniṣadādigatanārāyaṇaśabdasya pūrvoktarītyā śivaparatvāvaśya(-)mbhāvāt| na ca gaṇapāṭhe arthaviśeṣaviśiṣṭacaśabdanirdeśo na duṣṭa
analyzed: na ca tatra chāndasa tvena nirvāhaḥ prakṛte api tulya tvāt subāla upaniṣad ādi gata nārāyaṇa śabdasya pūrvokta rītyā śiva paratva avaśyambhāvāt na ca gaṇa pāṭhe artha viśeṣa viśiṣṭa caśabda nirdeśaḥ na duṣṭa

original: cara iti vācyam| tindo gotrāditi kutsanābhīkṣṇayoriti sūtretido gotrādīniti yogaṃ vibhajya tasya tindaḥ pareṣāṃ gotrādīnā nighātavidhāyakatvamāśritya
analyzed: caraḥ iti vācyam tindaḥ gotrāt iti kutsana abhīkṣṇayoḥ iti gotra ādīn iti yogam vibhajya tasya tindaḥ pareṣām nighāta vidhāyaka tvam āśritya

original: kutsanābhīkṣṇayorityaṃśasya ca paribhāṣātvamāśritya tatra gotrādīnītyana(nu)vartya yatra yatra gotrādīni śrūyate
analyzed: kutsana abhīkṣṇayoḥ iti aṃśasya ca paribhāṣā tvam āśritya tatra gotra ādīni iti an anuvartya yatra yatra gotra ādīni śrūyate

original: tatra sarvatra kutsanābhīkṣṇya(-)viṣayāṇyeva tāni bodhyāni tena cānaci divagotrāditaddhitāmreḍiteṣvagateriti sūtre'pi ca vanādiṣu pareṣu agateḥ parasya nindantasya nighātaniṣedhavidhāyake kutsanābhīkṣṇyaviṣayakā
analyzed: tatra sarvatra kutsana ābhīkṣṇya viṣayāṇi eva tāni bodhyāni tena ca an aci diva gotra ādi taddhita āmreḍiteṣu agateḥ iti sūtre api ca vana ādiṣu pareṣu agateḥ parasya nindantasya nighāta niṣedha vidhāyake kutsana ābhīkṣṇya viṣayakā

original: ṇāmeva grahaṇaṃ sidhyati ekayogatve kṛtaṃ na sidhyatīti sarvavaiyākaraṇairvyākhyātatvena kutsanābhīkṣṇyarūpārthaviśeṣasyaiva gotrādipāṭhasya paryavasānādata eva kāśikāyāṃ kutsanābhīkṣṇyagrahaṇaṃ caitat
analyzed: ṇām eva grahaṇam sidhyati eka yoga tve kṛtam na sidhyati iti sarva vaiyākaraṇaiḥ vyākhyāta tvena kutsana ābhīkṣṇya rūpa artha viśeṣasya eva gotra ādi pāṭhasya paryavasānāt atas eva kāśikāyām kutsana ābhīkṣṇya grahaṇam ca etat

original: pāṭhaviśeṣaṇaṃ veditavyamityuktaṃ kiṃ ca pāṭhāt paryudāsyaḥ| paṭhitānāṃ saṃjñākaraṇamiti sarvādīni sarvanāmānīti sūtrasthavārtikena saṃjñopasarjanabhinnānāmeva sarvādīnāṃ sarvanāmagaṇe pāṭha ityuktatvāt tasya cārtha
analyzed: pāṭha viśeṣaṇam veditavyam iti uktam kim ca pāṭhāt paryudāsyaḥ paṭhitānām saṃjñā karaṇam iti sarva ādīni sarvanāmāni iti sūtra stha vārtikena saṃjñā upasarjana bhinnānām eva sarva ādīnām sarvanāma gaṇe pāṭhaḥ iti ukta tvāt tasya ca arthaḥ

original: viśeṣaviśiṣṭānāmeva sarvā(-)dīnāṃ sarvādigaṇe pāṭha ityatra paryavasānāt ata eva tatra kaiyyaṭo yathā dindo gotrādīnityatra kutsanābhīkṣṇyayorityetat gotrādigaṇapāṭhaviśeṣaṇamityartha
